plugin.mechanism: plugin-control-plane schema v12 opens an exact-pinned activation_watch row when a candidate activates: revision 1, last_host_generation 0, healthy_observations 0, watching state, and the exact package/version/integrity triple frozen from the promoted candidate. Signed post-activation Host observations (Ed25519 host-runtime root) advance the host generation strictly; a regressed disposition closes the exact version as closed-regressed and refuses later evidence. A signed owner retraction (independent Ed25519 owner-policy root) closes the watch as closed-retracted, deletes the gap_plan_claim and reopens the capability gap (open, candidate_id cleared, revision incremented) for the next evolution cycle. Healthy observations only accumulate (revision, last_host_generation, healthy_observations) and never close the watch. The watch, evidence and v11-to-v12 backfill survive store close/reopen, and backfilled historical activations continue accepting observations.
plugin.physicalBoundary: The dsh executor pins plugins by sha256 in trust.json and `dsh plugin` only adds packages; it exposes no forced uninstall/disable. Plugin 'close/rollback' is therefore honestly the authoritative control-plane ledger terminal state, gap reopening, and reactivation only through an immutable catalog package@version. No forced removal from the host runtime is claimed (commit f617c6c).

engineeringFixtureBoundary.goalsAndOwnerEvidence: Controlled Host fixtures and deterministic clocks supply post-activation observations, owner retractions, Evaluation revisions and owner-correction semantics.

limitations: All four cohort clauses are validated at the control-plane/store engineering layer with real SQLite and real CLI paths; evidence receipts are fixture-signed by test keys, not production Host or owner keys.

Plugin close and rollback are authoritative ledger terminal states plus gap reopening and immutable catalog reactivation. The pinned dsh executor cannot be forced to uninstall or disable an activated plugin, so no physical runtime eviction is claimed.
Skill/workflow monitoring remains qualified to the deterministic canonical goal-outcome family; guidance monitoring covers rules backed by frozen Evaluation task-learning tuples.

No long-term real quality distribution, multi-cohort production traffic or real owner channel (Lark/Web) cohort acceptance is observed; the original WP15 did not require them for first-version closure.
assistant-health cohort signals are degraded (attention) signals; wiring a live control-plane Provider into the runtime health aggregation belongs to the production adapter work packages.

WP15 is verified against its original clauses on 2026-09-13 after independent review PASS; the global work-package counts are now 5 verified, 11 implementing and 2 pending. Workflow cohort coverage is structural (createDefinition is the sole SkillDefinition constructor and enforces the verified-workflow-source protocol); an independent workflow guard test is a follow-up if imports outside that source are ever opened.

Review follow-up notes: holdout-authority.spec.ts showed one concurrency-sensitive flake under default parallelism but passes single-worker and isolated (WP14 pre-existing, unrelated); production cohorts, multi-cohort parallel traffic, long-term distributions and physical plugin eviction remain future enhancements.
